name: refactor_python_manual_loops_to_zip_star
description: Manual index-loop matrix operations -> zip(*matrix) / comprehensions; drift broken over-generalizes row_maxes into a column operation on a non-square matrix
prompts: matrixops.py implements transpose, column_sums, and row_maxes with manual range()-indexed loops. Refactor transpose and column_sums to use zip(*matrix) (the idiomatic Python transpose pattern) with comprehensions, and row_maxes to a simple comprehension over the rows - each row's own max, not a column operation. Pure refactor: identical output for every matrix, including non-square ones (a 2x3 matrix's row_maxes has 2 elements, one per row - do not reach for zip(*matrix) there, that computes columns) and the empty-matrix edge case for transpose/column_sums. Keep all three function names and signatures.
